title: Site construction for the closed complement of a subterminal sheaf
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-topos] with finite limits, terminal object $X$, and subcanonical topology, meaning that every presheaf $h_V(W)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(W,V)$ is a $J$-sheaf. Let $U\to X$ be a monomorphism and set $F=h_U\hookrightarrow h_X=1$. On the same underlying category define a family $\{V_i\to V\}$ to cover for $J_c$ precisely when the family $\{V_i\to V\}\cup\{U\times_XV\to V\}$ is $J$-covering (a family is covering when its generated sieve is covering). These families define a Grothendieck topology $J_c$. The identity on underlying presheaves defines a fully faithful functor $I:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J_c)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J)$. It is the direct image of a geometric morphism $q$ [def-trf-geometric-morphism], and its essential image consists exactly of the $J$-sheaves $G$ such that $F\times G\to F$ is an isomorphism. All representables in this statement are sheaves for $J$; no subcanonicity of $J_c$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08LY (lemma-closed-subtopos), modified covering construction and essential-image identification, on the subcanonical finite-limit site chosen at the start of its proof.
